entities.name: PMID:25442459
observations: Christopoulos et al. studied 636 CTO PCI procedures at six high-volume US centers from January 2012 to March 2014.
Target vessels were RCA 387 (61%), LAD 132 (21%), and LCX 117 (18%).

entities.name: LCX CTO PCI outcomes
observations: Procedural success was lower for LCX CTO PCI (84.6%) than RCA (91.7%) or LAD (94.7%; P=0.016).
Major complications were numerically higher with LCX PCI (4.3%) than RCA (1.0%) or LAD (2.3%), but the difference was not statistically significant (P=0.07).
LCX CTO PCI had less procedural efficiency, including longer fluoroscopy and high contrast use, compared with LAD and RCA procedures.
